integrity.model_assumptions: Finite rooted trees with independently open homogeneous edges; fixed root source.
integrity.proof_type: Exact moments, coefficient sign variation, rational bounds and Descartes rule.

scientific_limitations: Extrema bound is proved for rooted brooms, not arbitrary rooted trees.
No minimal network size is asserted.
Independent bond occupation is not generally equivalent to SIR transmission with random infectious periods.
The two modes concern a variance-versus-parameter curve, not an outbreak-size probability distribution.
Historical priority is provisional pending independent comprehensive literature comparison.
title: Two peaks and a three-critical-point bound for rooted-broom outbreak variance
